strings: r_c0 watches as m_c wakes yet again with flattened ears and a racing heart. It seems {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} shock has returned this moon, fresh as the day it first occurred.
m_c's shock feels fresh, the event from the past flashing before {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} eyes and making {PRONOUN/m_c/object} shake and shiver, wishing to just curl back up in the den and not leave.
Breathing harshly, m_c creeps around the camp towards the medicine den, every step shaky and weak.
